about: Buying moments for India and the US. Use the specific local moment the buyer keeps, not a generic 'festive season'. Dates for lunar and moon-sighted festivals move every year: 2026 and 2027 dates are given only where a holiday list or panchang was checked; otherwise check the year's calendar. Islamic festival dates depend on moon sighting and can move by a day. lead_time_days is when ads should start before the day; work delivery cutoffs back from the courier lanes.

moments.name: Diwali (Deepavali)
moments.when: Kartika new moon, October or November; five days from Dhanteras to Bhai Dooj. 2026: Sun 8 Nov. 2027: Fri 29 Oct (central government holiday lists). Some southern states mark Naraka Chaturdashi the day before.
moments.buyers: Families buying for the home and for each other; employers and businesses buying gifts for staff and clients.
moments.angle: Homes are cleaned, lit and dressed, and families exchange sweets and gifts.
moments.watch_out: Peak ad costs and sale fatigue; courier delays; false urgency is a banned dark pattern under India's 2023 guidelines.

moments.name: Dhanteras
moments.when: First day of Diwali, 13th lunar day of the dark fortnight. 2026: Fri 6 Nov. 2027: Wed 27 Oct (Drik Panchang, New Delhi).
moments.buyers: Households buying gold, silver and new utensils for good fortune.
moments.angle: Buying gold, silver or new vessels on this day is believed to bring good fortune.
moments.watch_out: Gold price swings; purity claims need hallmark proof.

moments.name: Bhai Dooj
moments.when: Last day of Diwali. 2026: Wed 11 Nov. 2027: Sun 31 Oct (Drik Panchang; 2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Brothers and sisters buying for each other, often across cities.
moments.angle: The sibling gift day that closes Diwali, when Diwali gifts are already bought.
moments.watch_out: Lost under Diwali noise; deliveries slow right after Diwali.

moments.name: Akshaya Tritiya
moments.when: Third lunar day of the bright half of Vaisakha, April or May. 2026: Sun 19 Apr. 2027: Sun 9 May (Drik Panchang).
moments.buyers: Families buying gold and starting new things; strong in Maharashtra and among jewellery buyers nationwide.
moments.angle: Work started and things bought on this day are believed to bring lasting success.
moments.watch_out: Every jeweller runs the same offer; lead with a real reason, not just 'making charges off'.

moments.name: Raksha Bandhan
moments.when: Shravana full moon, usually August. 2026: Fri 28 Aug. 2027: Tue 17 Aug (Drik Panchang; 2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Sisters sending rakhis, often by post to brothers far away; brothers buying gifts in return. Includes buyers abroad.
moments.angle: A sister ties a rakhi and receives a gift; rakhis are mailed to brothers who live far away.
moments.watch_out: Courier cutoffs, especially international; promise only delivery dates the courier meets.

moments.name: Karva Chauth
moments.when: Fourth day of the waning moon in Kartika, about 11 days before Diwali. 2026: Thu 29 Oct. 2027: Mon 18 Oct (Drik Panchang; 2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Married women fasting for their husbands; husbands and mothers-in-law buying gifts.
moments.angle: Women dress in red and gold, wear new jewellery bought in advance, and apply mehndi for the evening rite.
moments.watch_out: Regional: mostly north and west India; do not run it nationwide.

moments.name: Navratri (Sharad)
moments.when: Nine nights in Ashvin, September or October, ending on Dussehra. 2026: starts Sun 11 Oct, Dussehra Tue 20 Oct. 2027: starts Thu 30 Sep, Dussehra Sat 9 Oct (Drik Panchang; central lists).
moments.buyers: Garba dancers and families dressing for nine nights; households buying for the puja.
moments.angle: Nine nights of dressing up, with a colour assigned to each day.
moments.watch_out: Clashes with marketplace festive sales; customs differ by state (garba in Gujarat, Golu in the south).

moments.name: Durga Puja
moments.when: Ashvin, September or October; main days Shashthi to Vijaya Dashami. 2026: 16 to 21 Oct. 2027: Ashtami Thu 7 Oct, Vijaya Dashami Sat 9 Oct; check the year's calendar for the other days.
moments.buyers: Families buying new clothes and gifts for relatives and friends; Bengali buyers in other cities and abroad.
moments.angle: New clothes are the traditional gift, worn for pandal hopping over the main days.
moments.watch_out: Puja shopping starts weeks early; ads that start the week before are late.

moments.name: Onam
moments.when: Ten days in Chingam (August or September) from Atham to Thiruvonam. Thiruvonam 2026: Wed 26 Aug. 2027: Sun 12 Sep (Drik Panchang; 2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Keralite families and Malayalis abroad buying new clothes (Onakkodi) and for the Onasadya feast.
moments.angle: Everyone wears new clothes, the kasavu saree above all, for the feast day.
moments.watch_out: Kerala only; Malayali diaspora in the Gulf and US is a second audience with longer shipping.

moments.name: Pongal
moments.when: First day of the Tamil month Thai, 14 or 15 January, with Bhogi the day before and Mattu and Kaanum Pongal after. 2026: Wed 14 Jan. 2027: Fri 15 Jan (Drik Panchang; 2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Tamil families renewing the home and buying new clothes; relatives exchanging gifts on Kaanum Pongal.
moments.angle: Bhogi clears out the old; Thai Pongal starts the year with new clothes and new pots.
moments.watch_out: Thai also opens the Tamil wedding season; do not mix the two messages.

moments.name: Makar Sankranti (Uttarayan, Sankranti)
moments.when: Sun enters Capricorn, usually 14 January (15 in some years). 2026: Wed 14 Jan. 2027: listed as 14 Jan in the central list and 15 Jan in Drik Panchang for New Delhi; check the local calendar.
moments.buyers: Families across states with different customs: kite flyers in Gujarat, tilgul givers in Maharashtra, four-day celebrations in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.
moments.angle: One solar day, many local rituals: kites in Gujarat, tilgul in Maharashtra, Ellu-Bella in Karnataka.
moments.watch_out: Write per state; one national message flattens the custom that makes it matter.

moments.name: Lohri
moments.when: Night before Makar Sankranti, usually 13 January, sometimes 14. Check the year's calendar.
moments.buyers: Punjabi families, especially homes with a first Lohri for a newborn or a newly married couple; their relatives buying gifts.
moments.angle: Homes with a recent wedding or birth hold the biggest Lohri celebrations.
moments.watch_out: Sources differ by a day in some years; confirm before dating ads.

moments.name: Ugadi and Gudi Padwa
moments.when: Chaitra Shukla Pratipada, late March or early April. 2026: Thu 19 Mar. 2027: Wed 7 Apr (Drik Panchang; 2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Telugu, Kannada and Marathi families starting the new year.
moments.angle: New year: the house is cleaned and new clothes bought.
moments.watch_out: Same day, different names and customs; localise the language and ritual.

moments.name: Vishu
moments.when: First day of Medam, 14 or 15 April. 2027: Wed 14 Apr (2027 central list). For 2026 sources differ (14 or 15 April); check the Malayalam calendar.
moments.buyers: Malayali families; elders giving money (Vishukkaineettam) to children; everyone buying new clothes (Vishukodi).
moments.angle: The first sight of the year (Vishukkani) and new clothes for the Malayali new year.
moments.watch_out: Kerala and diaspora only; falls near Bihu and Puthandu, so split by region.

moments.name: Rongali (Bohag) Bihu
moments.when: Mid-April, around 14 to 15 April, the Assamese new year. Sources differ by a day; check the year's calendar.
moments.buyers: Assamese families; younger people giving gamosas to elders; children getting new clothes.
moments.angle: Elders are given a gamosa and children new clothes on Manuh Bihu.
moments.watch_out: Assam only; Magh Bihu (January) is a different, food-led festival.

moments.name: Eid al-Fitr
moments.when: End of Ramadan, set by moon sighting. 2026: Sat 21 Mar. 2027: Wed 10 Mar (central government lists; may shift by a day).
moments.buyers: Muslim families shopping through Ramadan for new clothes, Eidi gifts for children and sweets.
moments.angle: New clothes, Eidi money for children and festive meals after a month of fasting.
moments.watch_out: Date depends on the moon; run the last-days message on a flexible end date.

moments.name: Eid al-Adha (Bakrid)
moments.when: 10 Dhu al-Hijjah, set by moon sighting. 2026: Wed 27 May. 2027: Mon 17 May (central government lists; may shift by a day).
moments.buyers: Muslim families preparing festive meals and dressing in their finest clothes for Eid prayer.
moments.angle: Finest clothes for Eid prayer, and meat shared with family, friends and the poor.
moments.watch_out: Respect the sacrifice ritual; avoid flippant food jokes.

moments.name: Christmas (India)
moments.when: Fixed: 25 December.
moments.buyers: Christian families, strongest in Kerala, Goa and the north-east; gift and party buyers in metros.
moments.angle: Gifts, decorations and family meals at year end.
moments.watch_out: Shares the window with year-end sales; avoid cliche snow imagery for most of India.

moments.name: Valentine's Day (India)
moments.when: Fixed: 14 February.
moments.buyers: Young couples in cities buying for partners.
moments.angle: A gift for a partner, often the first jewellery gift.
moments.watch_out: Some buyers keep it private; avoid public-display assumptions.

moments.name: Mother's Day (India)
moments.when: Kept in India on the second Sunday of May, following the US date. 2026: 10 May. 2027: 9 May.
moments.buyers: Adult children, often in other cities, sending gifts to mothers.
moments.angle: A gift sent home by a child who lives away.
moments.watch_out: Delivery to tier-2 and tier-3 towns takes longer; set cutoffs by pin code.

moments.name: Father's Day (India)
moments.when: Kept in India on the third Sunday of June, following the US date. 2026: 21 Jun. 2027: 20 Jun.
moments.buyers: Adult children buying for fathers.
moments.angle: A practical gift a father would not buy himself.
moments.watch_out: Smaller than Mother's Day; keep spend in line.

moments.name: International Women's Day
moments.when: Fixed: 8 March.
moments.buyers: Women buying for themselves; companies buying for women staff.
moments.angle: A reason to buy for yourself, or for the women on a team.
moments.watch_out: Discount-only or pink-washed ads read as tokenism; the day is about equal rights.

moments.name: Wedding season (north and west India)
moments.when: Weddings are avoided during Chaturmas (from Devshayani Ekadashi in Ashadha to Prabodhini or Dev Uthani Ekadashi, roughly July to November). The season restarts at Dev Uthani Ekadashi (about 20 Nov 2026) and runs in muhurat windows through winter and spring; most calendars pause for Kharmas from mid-December to mid-January. Exact muhurat dates vary by panchang; check the year's list.
moments.buyers: Brides, grooms and their families buying months ahead; guests buying outfits and gifts weeks ahead.
moments.angle: Families buy around fixed muhurat dates, so the date drives the deadline.
moments.watch_out: Muhurat lists differ by source; never name a 'last auspicious date' you have not checked.

moments.name: Wedding season (Tamil Nadu)
moments.when: Tamil months: Thai (mid-January to mid-February) and Aavani (mid-August to mid-September) are the most favoured; Vaikasi and Aani (May to July) are also popular. Aadi (mid-July to mid-August) and Margazhi (mid-December to mid-January) are avoided for weddings. Check the year's panchangam for dates.
moments.buyers: Tamil families buying silk sarees, gold and wedding gifts, and guests buying outfits.
moments.angle: Thai brings a wedding rush because Margazhi before it is kept free of weddings.
moments.watch_out: Do not run wedding ads in Aadi or Margazhi; shift to Aadi sale or season messages instead.

moments.name: Margazhi music and dance season (Chennai)
moments.when: Chennai's music season runs about mid-November to January, centred on the Tamil month Margazhi (mid-December to mid-January). Check each year's sabha schedules.
moments.buyers: Carnatic music and dance audiences going to concerts day after day, performers, and visitors from across India and abroad.
moments.angle: Weeks of daily concerts give a repeat reason to dress up, and a gift for the music lover.
moments.watch_out: Margazhi is avoided for weddings; keep wedding messages out.

moments.name: Aadi sale season
moments.when: The Tamil month Aadi, mid-July to mid-August, with Aadi Perukku on the 18th day. Check the year's Tamil calendar.
moments.buyers: Tamil Nadu shoppers who wait for the Aadi discount, especially on textiles, sarees and home goods.
moments.angle: Weddings pause in Aadi, so retailers run their biggest discounts and buyers plan around them.
moments.watch_out: A discount-led season; check break-even and do not train buyers to wait for every month.

moments.name: Varalakshmi Vratham
moments.when: Friday before Shravana full moon, July or August. 2026: Fri 28 Aug. 2027: Fri 13 Aug (Drik Panchang).
moments.buyers: Married women in south India performing the puja for family well-being.
moments.angle: The kalasha is dressed in a saree and gold jewellery for the goddess.
moments.watch_out: Devotional: keep creative respectful; south India only.

moments.name: Teej (Hariyali and Hartalika)
moments.when: Hariyali Teej in Shravana: 2026 Sat 15 Aug, 2027 Wed 4 Aug. Hartalika Teej in Bhadrapada: 2026 Mon 14 Sep, 2027 Fri 3 Sep (Drik Panchang).
moments.buyers: Married women; parents sending a sindhara gift to married daughters.
moments.angle: Parents send married daughters clothes, bangles and henna; women dress in green and red.
moments.watch_out: Two Teejs in different regions; match the name and date to the state.

moments.name: Chhath Puja
moments.when: Four days in Kartika, the week after Diwali. 2026: 13 to 16 Nov (main evening offering 15 Nov). 2027: Thu 4 Nov (2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Families from Bihar, Jharkhand and eastern Uttar Pradesh, at home and in cities like Delhi and Mumbai.
moments.angle: Four days of fasting and offerings to the sun, prepared at home in bamboo baskets.
moments.watch_out: A strict devotional rite; no jokes, no discount noise.

moments.name: Holi
moments.when: Phalguna full moon, usually March; Holika Dahan bonfire the night before. 2026: Wed 4 Mar. 2027: Tue 23 Mar in the central list, with Holika Dahan the night before.
moments.buyers: Families and friends playing with colours; hosts buying sweets and party supplies.
moments.angle: A day of colours and water, so buyers prepare skin, hair and old clothes before and clean up after.
moments.watch_out: 'Safe' or 'natural' colour claims need proof.

moments.name: Ganesh Chaturthi
moments.when: Bhadrapada, late August to September; up to 10 days to Anant Chaturdashi. 2026: Mon 14 Sep. 2027: Sat 4 Sep (Drik Panchang; 2027 central list).
moments.buyers: Families booking idols in advance, decorating homes and hosting visitors.
moments.angle: Families book idols early and decorate a space at home for days of visitors.
moments.watch_out: Eco-friendly claims need proof; immersion customs vary.

moments.name: Independence Day sales
moments.when: Fixed: 15 August. Marketplace 'freedom' sales open about a week before (in 2026, from 7 Aug with member early access on 6 Aug).
moments.buyers: Deal hunters on marketplaces, mostly electronics and fashion.
moments.angle: A mid-year sale window between summer and the festive season.
moments.watch_out: Indian law restricts using the national flag or emblem to sell goods; do not put them in ads.

moments.name: Festive marketplace sales (Big Billion Days, Great Indian Festival)
moments.when: Usually late September or early October, just before or at Navratri. In 2026 Great Indian Festival started 8 Oct and ran to 10 Nov; Big Billion Days started 9 Oct with early access on 8 Oct. Dates are announced a few weeks ahead each year.
moments.buyers: Most online shoppers in India, including first-time buyers from smaller towns.
moments.angle: Buyers hold purchases for these weeks; D2C stores either ride the window or give a reason to buy direct.
moments.watch_out: Ad costs spike and deep marketplace discounts set price anchors; never fake a 'lowest price' claim.

moments.name: Salary days
moments.when: Monthly: the last working days of the month to the first week of the next. Indian wage law sets monthly wages due by about the 7th day after the wage period (10th for very large employers).
moments.buyers: Salaried buyers who plan larger or treat purchases for payday.
moments.angle: The week money arrives is when wish-list items get bought.
moments.watch_out: Do not push credit or 'buy now, pay later' pressure; budget-strained buyers return more.

moments.name: Back to college (India)
moments.when: July to August; recent UGC guidance has first-year classes start by the first week of August and later years by the third week of July. Check each year's notice.
moments.buyers: Students moving to hostels or new cities, and parents buying for them.
moments.angle: A move to a new city or hostel needs a full kit at once.
moments.watch_out: Admission timelines slip in some years; keep dates soft.

moments.name: Black Friday
moments.when: Day after Thanksgiving (fourth Thursday of November). 2026: Fri 27 Nov. 2027: Fri 26 Nov.
moments.buyers: Holiday gift buyers and deal seekers; a record 202.9 million people shopped Thanksgiving to Cyber Monday 2025 (NRF).
moments.angle: The start of holiday gift buying, when shoppers expect the year's best offer.
moments.watch_out: Sale fatigue and peak ad costs; former prices must be real and fake countdowns are deceptive.

moments.name: Cyber Monday
moments.when: Monday after Thanksgiving. 2026: 30 Nov. 2027: 29 Nov.
moments.buyers: Online shoppers finishing the Thanksgiving weekend; second-biggest online day of the weekend in 2025 (NRF).
moments.angle: Last day of the weekend offers, bought online.
moments.watch_out: Extending 'last chance' offers repeatedly erodes trust.

moments.name: Thanksgiving
moments.when: Fourth Thursday of November. 2026: Thu 26 Nov. 2027: Thu 25 Nov.
moments.buyers: Hosts preparing meals and homes; guests bringing hostess gifts.
moments.angle: Hosting the family meal: the table, the kitchen and the gift for the host.
moments.watch_out: Drowned by Black Friday; lead with hosting, not discounts.

moments.name: Christmas and the holiday season (US)
moments.when: Fixed: 25 December. USPS recommended 2026 send-by dates for contiguous US: Ground Advantage 17 Dec, Priority Mail 18 Dec, Priority Mail Express 19 Dec. Check each year's carrier dates.
moments.buyers: Gift buyers for family, friends and colleagues; late shoppers switching to gift cards.
moments.angle: Gifts that arrive in time; after the cutoff, gift cards and local pickup still work.
moments.watch_out: Promise only the carrier's dates; switch messaging after the cutoff.

moments.name: Valentine's Day (US)
moments.when: Fixed: 14 February.
moments.buyers: Partners, friends and family; NRF forecast a record $29.1 billion for 2026.
moments.angle: A gift for someone you love, partner or not.
moments.watch_out: Shipping cutoffs for a fixed day; avoid assuming every buyer is in a couple.

moments.name: Mother's Day (US)
moments.when: Second Sunday in May (36 U.S.C. 117). 2026: 10 May. 2027: 9 May.
moments.buyers: Adult children and partners; NRF forecast a record $38 billion for 2026, with jewellery the top category at $7.5 billion.
moments.angle: Thanks for a mother, often a keepsake she will wear.
moments.watch_out: Offer an opt-out from Mother's Day emails for buyers who find the day hard.

moments.name: Father's Day (US)
moments.when: Third Sunday in June (36 U.S.C. 109). 2026: 21 Jun. 2027: 20 Jun.
moments.buyers: Adult children and partners.
moments.angle: A practical upgrade he would not buy for himself.
moments.watch_out: Avoid tired dad cliches; offer an email opt-out.

moments.name: Graduation season (US)
moments.when: May to June, by school. Check local commencement dates.
moments.buyers: Family and friends of high school and college graduates; NRF expected a record $7.2 billion in 2026, with cash the top gift.
moments.angle: A keepsake or a useful first-job gift that beats cash.
moments.watch_out: Cash is the default; the ad must say why a thing is better.

moments.name: Back to school and college (US)
moments.when: Mid-July to early September by district; NRF found 62% had started shopping by early July 2026.
moments.buyers: Parents of K-12 students and college students; NRF forecast a record $43.3 billion for K-12 and $103.5 billion for college in 2026.
moments.angle: A new school year needs a full kit, and families shop early for deals.
moments.watch_out: Starts earlier each year; ads in August are late for many families.

moments.name: Prime Day window
moments.when: Set by Amazon each year, usually announced weeks ahead. 2026 ran 23 to 26 June (earlier than the usual July). Check the year's announcement.
moments.buyers: Deal-seeking online shoppers across categories.
moments.angle: Shoppers are in buying mode; off-Amazon stores can match the window with their own reason to buy.
moments.watch_out: Ad costs rise across platforms that week; do not claim to be part of the event.

moments.name: Singles' Day (11.11)
moments.when: Fixed: 11 November.
moments.buyers: Shoppers who follow Asian e-commerce events; low reach for most US stores.
moments.angle: The world's biggest shopping day in China; relevant only if your buyers keep it.
moments.watch_out: Falls on Veterans Day in the US; most US buyers do not know it.

moments.name: Lunar New Year
moments.when: New moon between late January and mid-February. 2026: Tue 17 Feb (Year of the Horse). 2027: Sat 6 Feb (Year of the Goat).
moments.buyers: Families buying new clothes, red envelopes and gifts for relatives and business contacts.
moments.angle: New clothes and shoes for a fresh start, and red envelopes for the young.
moments.watch_out: Get the zodiac animal and customs right; avoid one-size 'Chinese New Year' stereotypes.

moments.name: Easter
moments.when: Western Easter Sunday moves each year. 2026: 5 Apr. 2027: 28 Mar.
moments.buyers: Families filling Easter baskets and dressing for church and family meals.
moments.angle: Baskets for children and spring outfits for the day.
moments.watch_out: A religious holiday for many; keep it respectful.

moments.name: Independence Day (July 4)
moments.when: Fixed: 4 July (federal observed date moves when it falls on a weekend: 3 Jul 2026, 5 Jul 2027). 2026 is the 250th anniversary of US independence.
moments.buyers: Hosts of cookouts and summer parties; summer sale shoppers.
moments.angle: A summer weekend of gatherings and travel.
moments.watch_out: Flag-heavy creative is crowded; misuse of the flag offends some buyers.

moments.name: Memorial Day sales
moments.when: Last Monday in May. 2026: 25 May. 2027: 31 May.
moments.buyers: Shoppers buying for summer: mattresses, furniture, outdoor and appliances.
moments.angle: The unofficial start of summer.
moments.watch_out: The day honours fallen service members; keep the tone respectful.

moments.name: Labor Day sales
moments.when: First Monday in September. 2026: 7 Sep. 2027: 6 Sep.
moments.buyers: End-of-summer shoppers and late back-to-school buyers.
moments.angle: The end of summer and the last back-to-school push.
moments.watch_out: Generic 'Labor Day sale' ads blur together; give a specific reason.
